Predeclared regularized-cohorts-v1: repeat the fixed same-affine ANTs SyN total_sigma=0.5, iterations 100/70/200 setting on the previously observed MMRR-21 11-to-12 and NKI-RS-22 8-to-9 cases. These extend the three completed OASIS observations to two other sourced cohorts without adding parameter variants. The original confirmation input manifest verifies prepared images and labels. Each original HalfFlow selected-fit command and inputs.sha256 verifies the identical generated saved affine used here, in addition to all fresh protocol hashes. Historical HalfFlow source identities are retained; their old timings are not treated as P01 timing evidence.

Both new reference attempts must converge natively at every enabled level before caps and pass all unchanged common geometry, coverage, inverse and sampled-cell gates; a single failure fails this two-case feasibility replication. All outcomes remain, and this small observed-data study cannot qualify the reference. One worker/native thread and the existing one-hour fit deadline remain. Runs overlap other diagnostic work, so all walltime and memory measurements are excluded from production comparisons. The fixed-reference driver is now running; isolated timing and broader reference validation remain outstanding. No fresh qualification data, optimizer candidate or softened numerical gate is introduced.
